summary: Tested the crew invite rework from start to finish: backend API (new pytest file, 19/19 pass, plus the existing test_crew_photos regression suite 31/31) and the UI at 390x844 for skipper, invitee and free user. Everything requested works. email_key canonical matching handles googlemail/dots/+tag variants, both for pending invites and for legacy /crew/join. Roles are deduped and capped (12 roles, 40 chars). Voyage notes are saved and sticky. Pending accept/decline works and is scoped to the invitee (another user gets 404). Expired, declined and already-crew invites are excluded. Removing crew also removes their roles. Role options are sourced in order: boat 'Crew Roles' list, then admin template, then roles already used. UI checks: missing-email error; Copy WhatsApp message/Copy link copy the right text, show a toast, clear email and roles and keep notes; Send email invite saves the invite; crew list shows role badges, 'Invited, joins when they log in' and 'Declined the invite'; notes are prefilled when the dialog reopens. Pending invite prompt: Join adds the boat to the picker with a Crew badge and switches to it; Not now hides it for the tab session (it shows again in a new tab); Decline works. A free user gets the plan-dialog upgrade prompt. No horizontal overflow at 390px.

minor.issue: Doesn't $unset crew_roles.<user_id>, so leaving crew leaves stale role data. remove_crew does clean it up.

DAILY_INVITE_LIMIT counts only crew_invites docs that still exist. Re-inviting deletes the older doc and cancelling deletes it too, so cancel or re-invite loops can send unlimited emails. Consider counting sends in a separate log. This was already the case before this change.

issues: crew-invite-error stays visible after the user types an email, until the next button press (minor). Could clear it in the email onChange.
Copy WhatsApp message/Copy link write to the clipboard before the POST. If the POST fails, the message is already copied but no invite exists (an error is shown, so this is minor).

action_items: Optional: clear crew-invite-error when the email input changes
Optional: make the daily invite limit resistant to delete/re-invite
critical_code_review_comments: Invites inserted without email_key after startup (only possible through direct DB inserts like the legacy test helper) won't appear in /crew/pending. The backfill runs only at startup. This is acceptable because the API always sets the key.
The pytest.ini default runs with xdist -n. test_crew_photos and test_crew_invites_v2 share PRO crew_invites cleanup, so run them with -n0 or run the files separately to avoid cross-file interference.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary invites on the Pro main boat (test_ui.crew1-4@example.com, beta, free) and beta joined as crew. All of it was removed afterwards: crew_invites for test-user-pro deleted, main boat crew=[], crew_roles unset, voyage_notes='', last_boat unset for beta/free. One Resend email went to test_ui.crew3@example.com and one to test_ui.crew4@example.com (both @example.com). The TEST_inv2/TEST_invA boats and the 'Crew Roles' admin template were created and then deleted by the test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest tests/test_crew_invites_v2.py -n0 (pytest.ini adds -n). The email_key strips ALL dots for gmail (chris.siekmann.cs -> chrissiekmanncs@gmail.com). Pending prompt 'Not now' uses per-tab sessionStorage key mbp_invites_later. Free user upgrade from crew-invite-open-btn opens data-testid=plan-dialog.
